accepted_lessons.name: evidence_derived_invalid_failure_lists
accepted_lessons.requirement: Derive the complete FIT and SELECT invalid-instrument clause lists from authority-bound retained evidence, sort them canonically, and require literal equality with the published failure classes and flattened failed-clause list.

accepted_lessons.name: unretained_checks_hard_abort
accepted_lessons.requirement: A failed check whose inputs are not retained in the evidence package aborts before result, receipt, or evidence publication and cannot be represented as a scientific-null clause.

accepted_lessons.name: live_structural_check_and_saved_proxy_are_distinct
accepted_lessons.requirement: Run the preregistered full-vocabulary final-logit structural identity live and hard-abort on mismatch; separately save and reconstruct the inserted-tensor identity without treating it as a substitute.

builder_prompt_addendum: For every ordinary FIT or SELECT invalid terminal, derive the exact canonically ordered failure list from retained authority-bound evidence and compare it literally with the result. Hard-abort every check whose full computational inputs are intentionally unretained. Run the preregistered live full-vocabulary structural identity and the saved inserted-tensor identity as two named checks; the saved local identity never replaces the live downstream check. Add planted complete-package mutations for every rule before model access.
critic_prompt_addendum: Attempt to publish invented, omitted, duplicated, reordered, and incorrectly SELECT-prefixed invalid reasons while keeping the evidence package internally hash-consistent. Raise every unretained integrity scalar and add matching text; publication must still fail. Plant equal inserted tensors with unequal final logits, unequal inserted tensors with equal final logits, missing current-split arm logits, and an authorized identity from a different unopened split. Require the live downstream check, saved local reconstruction, and split filtering to remain distinct.

hard_abort_contract.reason: the completed evidence package does not retain enough primitive tensors to independently recompute these checks
